domain: Chemical toxicology and molecular structure analysis
summary: This database stores chemical molecules and their structural composition for toxicology research. The core entities are molecules (identified by molecule_id with a toxicity label), atoms (with element symbols as text), and bonds (with bond type as text character like "-"). The connected table represents the molecular graph, linking atom pairs through bonds; note that each bond appears twice in connected (once in each direction) to represent bidirectional connectivity. Join paths require following molecule_id first to scope atoms and bonds, then using atom_id pairs through the connected table to traverse molecular structure.
